text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I did it... Trainer, I did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I kept my first promise! I won the
Takarazuka
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pull Mejiro Ryan, who's flexing a
victory pose,
over to a more suitable
location.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming to see me today,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I was able to pay you back for all the
support you've given me! But I still need
your help, 'cause
I'm gonna win the
Arima Kinen too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My goodness. Is flashing one's muscles a

respectable greeting? This girl...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, I'm going to entrust the Mejiro

medium-distance races to you for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've lost today, my plan is to
focus on
being a stayer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course, there is a distance where both of us can aptly display our strengths.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us meet at the illustrious Nakayama

Racecourse, for the year-end Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Obviously you'll be an even bigger star
than you
are now. I hope you grow to
become an exquisite
lady.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer... How am I supposed to do
that in just
six months?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may be a taller task than becoming a
star
racer... But we'll have to see what
we can do.
